Class PortOperator.PortBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.model.json.creators.PortOperator.PortBuilder
Enclosing class:
PortOperator
public class PortOperator.PortBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for PortCreatorJson. Each setter returns this; create() sends the POST and returns the created port wrapped as a Port.

ianjones

  • Method Details

    • dryRun

      public PortOperator.PortBuilder dryRun()
      Marks this create as a validate-only dry run: create() sends POST /fabric/v4/ports?dryRun=true (spec: "option to verify that API calls will succeed"; boolean, default false). No port is ordered — the API responds 200 (rather than the real create's 202) with the validated port order echoed back, so the returned Port carries no uuid/name/state.
      Returns:
      this builder
